landmarks.name: Machu Picchu
landmarks.writeup: An ancient Incan city set high in the Andes Mountains, renowned for its archaeological significance and stunning panoramic views.

landmarks.name: Nazca Lines
landmarks.writeup: A series of large ancient geoglyphs in the Nazca Desert, depicting various animals and shapes, visible from the air.

landmarks.name: Lake Titicaca
landmarks.writeup: The highest navigable lake in the world, shared with Bolivia, known for its cultural heritage and floating reed islands.

landmarks.name: Colca Canyon
landmarks.writeup: One of the deepest canyons in the world, famous for condor sightings and traditional Andean villages.

landmarks.name: Historic Centre of Lima
landmarks.writeup: The capital city's colonial core, featuring Spanish Baroque architecture and significant cultural landmarks.

cultural_events.name: Inti Raymi
cultural_events.writeup: A traditional Incan festival celebrating the winter solstice and the Sun God, held annually in Cusco.

cultural_events.name: Fiesta de la Candelaria
cultural_events.writeup: A vibrant religious and cultural festival in Puno featuring music, dance, and colorful costumes.

cultural_events.name: Semana Santa
cultural_events.writeup: Holy Week celebrations with processions and religious ceremonies across the country.

food_writeup: Peruvian cuisine is diverse, blending indigenous ingredients with Spanish, African, and Asian influences. Signature dishes include ceviche, lomo saltado, and ají de gallina, showcasing fresh seafood, potatoes, and native spices.
brief_history: Peru was home to the Inca Empire before Spanish conquest in the 16th century. It gained independence in 1821 and has since developed a rich cultural heritage influenced by indigenous and colonial histories.

important_people.name: Simón Bolívar
important_people.description: Liberator and key figure in South American independence

important_people.name: Túpac Amaru II
important_people.description: Leader of indigenous uprising against Spanish rule

important_people.name: Clorinda Matto de Turner
important_people.description: Influential writer and advocate for indigenous rights

current_conflicts: Peru faces internal challenges including political instability and social protests related to governance and economic inequality, but no active armed conflicts.
